channel.title: The Hit List
channel.desc: More famous faces step up to the challenge in a special edition of the music quiz. Competing for their chosen charities are comedy performer La Voix and quiz legend Jenny Ryan, presenter Rav Wilding and singer Chesney Hawkes, and comedians Fatiha El-Ghorri and Harriet Kemsley. Who will identify the hits fastest and make it to the final? Get ready to shout the answers at the TV!
